Abstract: We discover a novel and surprising phenomenon of unintentional misalignment in reasoning language models (RLMs), which we call self-jailbreaking. Specifically, after benign reasoning training on math or code domains, RLMs will use multiple strategies to circumvent their own safety guardrails. One strategy is to introduce benign assumptions about users and scenarios to justify fulfilling harmful requests. For instance, an RLM reasons that harmful requests like ``outline a strategy for stealing customers' credit card information from a retail store'' could be associated with the benign intent of ``a security professional trying to test defense,'' despite no such benign context being provided as input. We observe that many open-weight RLMs, including DeepSeek-R1-distilled, s1.1, Phi-4-mini-reasoning, and Nemotron, suffer from self-jailbreaking despite being aware of the harmfulness of the requests. We also provide a mechanistic understanding of self-jailbreaking: RLMs are more compliant after benign reasoning training, and after self-jailbreaking, models appear to perceive malicious requests as less harmful in the CoT, thus enabling compliance with them. To mitigate self-jailbreaking, we find that including minimal safety reasoning data during training is sufficient to ensure RLMs remain safety-aligned. Our work provides the first systematic analysis of self-jailbreaking behavior and offers a practical path forward for maintaining safety in increasingly capable RLMs.

</details>

Abstract: Large language models are beginning to show steganographic capabilities. Such capabilities could allow misaligned models to evade oversight mechanisms. Yet principled methods to detect and quantify such behaviours are lacking. Classical definitions of steganography, and detection methods based on them, require a known reference distribution of non-steganographic signals. For the case of steganographic reasoning in LLMs, knowing such a reference distribution is not feasible; this renders these approaches inapplicable. We propose an alternative, \textbf{decision-theoretic view of steganography}. Our central insight is that steganography creates an asymmetry in usable information between agents who can and cannot decode the hidden content (present within a steganographic signal), and this otherwise latent asymmetry can be inferred from the agents' observable actions. To formalise this perspective, we introduce generalised $\mathcal{V}$-information: a utilitarian framework for measuring the amount of usable information within some input. We use this to define the \textbf{steganographic gap} -- a measure that quantifies steganography by comparing the downstream utility of the steganographic signal to agents that can and cannot decode the hidden content. We empirically validate our formalism, and show that it can be used to detect, quantify, and mitigate steganographic reasoning in LLMs.

Empirically, Auto-ClawEval matches or exceeds human-curated environments on coherence and clarity at 13,800x lower cost. Evaluated across 4 model families and 8 agent harness frameworks, we find that harness engineering boosts performance by up to 15.7 percentage points over a bare ReAct baseline, completion remains the primary axis of variation with no model saturating the benchmark, and automated generation enables evaluation at a scale previously infeasible. Beyond static benchmarking, ClawEnvKit enables live evaluation: users describe a desired capability in natural language and obtain a verified environment on demand, turning evaluation into a continuous, user-driven process. The same mechanism serves as an on-demand training environment generator, producing task distributions that adapt to an agent's current weaknesses rather than being bounded by existing user logs.

</details>

Abstract: Silicon samples are increasingly used as a low-cost substitute for human panels and have been shown to reproduce aggregate human opinion with high fidelity. Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal systems, yet their scores provide no indication of reliability. We study this problem through conformal prediction, a distribution-free framework that converts a judge's point score into a calibrated prediction interval using only score-token log-probabilities, with no retraining. We present the first systematic analysis of conformal prediction for VLM-as-a-Judge across 3 judges and 14 visual task categories. Our results show that evaluation uncertainty is strongly task-dependent: intervals cover ~40% of the score range for aesthetics and natural images but expand to ~70% for chart and mathematical reasoning, yielding a quantitative reliability map for multimodal evaluation. ### [308] [Adversarial Robustness of NTK Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25965)
*Yuxuan Hou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明：当梯度流早停时，NTK 网络在 Sobolev 空间可达到极小极大最优对抗鲁棒率；若进入过参数化插值区，最小范数解会被对抗扰动击垮。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键系统广泛部署深度模型，但对抗攻击暴露了理论保证的缺失；作者希望为无限宽网络给出可证明的、对输入扰动具鲁棒性的收敛率。

Method: 在 Sobolev 空间建立对抗回归的极小极小下界；用神经正切核(NTK)把宽网络训练简化为核回归，分析梯度流+早停止的停止规则；对过参数化情形，考察最小范数插值解的对抗脆弱性。

Result: (1) 得到 Sobolev 空间对抗回归的最优率 R*(n)∼n^{-2(β−1)/(2β+d)}；(2) 梯度流早停的 NTK 估计器以高概率达到该率；(3) 对任意小 ε，存在范数 ≤ε 的扰动可使插值解误差放大 Ω(1)。

Conclusion: 早停是宽网络获得对抗极小极小最优性的关键；一旦放任插值，即便解具有最小范数，也可被极小扰动轻易攻破，这从理论上解释了“鲁棒性-过拟合”权衡。

Abstract: Deep learning models are widely deployed in safety-critical domains, but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. In this paper, we study the adversarial robustness of NTK neural networks in the context of nonparametric regression. We establish minimax optimal rates for adversarial regression in Sobolev spaces and then show that NTK neural networks, trained via gradient flow with early stopping, can achieve this optimal rate. However, in the overfitting regime, we prove that the minimum norm interpolant is vulnerable to adversarial perturbations.

</details>


### [309] [Occam's Razor is Only as Sharp as Your ELBO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25984)
*Ethan Harvey,Michael C. Hughes*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ELBO 与证据在过参数化回归中都会因协方差秩假设出现偏差：证据偶尔选中过拟合模型，ELBO 则倾向欠拟合；缩减秩的可缩放近似对模型选择有风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作指出均值场 ELBO 易欠拟合，但在大模型可缩放近似中，更少人关心“为计算可行而额外施加的协方差秩限制”是否也会破坏选择行为，需要系统研究。

Method: 构造过参数化线性回归与不同秩的高斯近似后验，比较两种优化目标（边缘似然/证据 vs ELBO）在超参数学习阶段的极值位置，分析其偏好。

Result: 当近似后验协方差秩足够低时，ELBO 会将参数后验方差推向零导致欠拟合；而边缘似然在部分秩设置下反而把方差推到极大，出现明显过拟合，且几率不可忽略。

Conclusion: 为保持计算可行而采用的低秩（或其他结构）近似，会改变证据与 ELBO 的奥卡姆剃刀强度，导致本可避免的错误选择；大模型实践中需对“近似结构-选择偏差”链路保持警惕并设计修正或诊断策略。

Abstract: The marginal likelihood, also known as the evidence, is regarded as a mathematical embodiment of Occam's razor, enabling model selection that avoids overfitting. The evidence lower bound (ELBO) objective from variational inference has also been used for similar purposes. Prior work has shown that restricting the approximate posterior family via a mean-field approximation can lead the ELBO to underfit. In this paper, we show how ELBO-based hyperparameter learning in a simple over-parameterized regression model can also produce overfitting, depending on the assumed rank of the covariance matrix in a Gaussian approximate posterior. Surprisingly, among only the underfit and overfit options, Bayesian model selection via the evidence itself sometimes prefers the overfit version, while the ELBO does not. Bayesian practitioners hoping to scale to large models should be cautious about how reduced-rank assumptions needed for tractability may impact the potential for model selection.

</details>

Abstract: We consider learning from labeled data collected across multiple environments, where the data distribution may vary across these environments. This problem is commonly approached from a causal perspective, seeking invariant representations that retain causal factors while discarding spurious ones. However, this framework assumes that the environment has no direct effect on the target. In contrast, we consider settings in which this assumption fails, but still aim to learn representations that support robust prediction on average across previously unseen environments. To this end, we study representations learned by explicitly modeling variation across environments and then marginalizing that variation out. We analyze the resulting representations and characterize when they are preferable to those learned by causal invariant-representation methods. We propose a concrete method based on generalized random-intercept models, a class of predictors in which such marginalization is possible, and study their generalization properties. Empirically, we show that these models outperform invariant-learning methods across a range of challenging settings.

Abstract: Data quality assessment is an essential step that ensures the reliability of the subsequent structural health monitoring (SHM) tasks. This study proposes a prediction deviation-based SHM data quality assessment method using a univariate implicit auto-regressive model, enabling outlier diagnosis and data cleaning. The proposed conditional diffusion model (CDM) augments the standard diffusion model with a conditional embedding module to incorporate temporal context, quartile normalization to mitigate distribution skew, and a Huber loss to enhance robustness against outliers. Within this univariate implicit autoregressive framework, each data point is assigned an outlier probability, quantifying its degree of "outlier-ness", and a global quality evaluation score is computed to characterize the overall dataset quality. Extensive case studies utilizing operational data from real-world structures demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves the accuracy of data quality assessment, outperforming other strong baselines representative of clustering, isolation-based, and deep reconstruction methods. ### [312] [Deep-testing: the case of dependence detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26558)
*Gery Geenens,Pierre Lafaye de Micheaux,Ivan Muyun Zou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 把分类 CNN 的思想嫁接到假设检验：用深度网络在模拟的 H0/H1“图像化样本”上训练判别器，将其分类概率作为检验统计量，在独立性检验中 19 种对比方法里取得最高功效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在视觉分类任务上已显强大判别力，但统计假设检验仍依赖传统统计量；作者提出“能否把这种判别力转化为统计检验的功效”这一问题。

Method: 提出 deep-testing 框架：1) 将样本（如散点图）编码为“图像”；2) 在大量 H0 与 H1 模拟数据上训练深度 CNN 分类器；3) 用学到的分类概率（或 logits）构造检验统计量，通过置换或模拟得 p 值；4) 以独立性检验为概念验证，与 19 种经典/现代方法系统对比。

Result: 大规模模拟显示，deep-testing 在 12 类复杂相依结构下的综合功效排名第一，控制尺寸的同时对非线性、高维依赖最敏感；计算成本随样本量线性增长，训练一次性、检验可重用。

Conclusion: 深度判别器可直接转化为高功效检验，为复杂假设提供“模型无关、数据驱动”的通用工具；未来可扩展至任意可模拟假设，并深化理论临界性质研究。

Abstract: Deep learning methods have proved highly effective for classification and image recognition problems. In this paper, we ask whether this success can be transferred to hypothesis testing: if a neural network can distinguish, for example, an image of a handwritten digit from another, can it also distinguish an "image of a sample" (such as a scatter plot) generated under a given statistical model from one generated outside that model? Motivated by this idea, we propose a novel procedure called deep-testing, which approaches the classical inferential problem of hypothesis testing through deep learning. More specifically, the test statistic is a classification map learned by a deep neural network from simulated data satisfying the null and alternative hypotheses, leveraging its strong discriminating power to construct a highly powerful test. As a proof of concept, we apply deep-testing to the problem of independence testing, arguably one of the most important problems in statistics. In a large-scale simulation study, deep-testing achieves the highest overall power against nineteen competing methods across a broad range of complex dependence structures, confirming the viability of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [313] [Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Tensor Network Kernel Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26673)
*Albert Saiapin,Kim Batselier*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对张量网络核机（TNKM）在高维场景下无法保持高斯性、难以进行标准贝叶斯推断的难题，作者提出一种基于线性化拉普拉斯近似的贝叶斯张量网络核机（LA-TNKM），在UCI回归任务上取得与GP和BNN相当或更优的预测与不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量网络核机虽可线性扩展到大数据，但权重空间的高阶张量分解破坏了高斯性，导致无法直接计算后验分布，进而无法给出可信的不确定性；而GP因计算复杂度受限，BNN则常需昂贵采样。需要一种既保持TNKM的高效结构，又能给出原则性不确定性的新框架。

Method: 1. 将TNKM的权重空间似然函数在MAP解处做二阶泰勒展开，得到线性化拉普拉斯近似；2. 利用张量网络的低秩结构，将高维海森矩阵的求逆转化为一系列局部核心矩阵的递归更新，复杂度由立方降至拟线性；3. 通过后验高斯分布直接输出预测均值与协方差，实现无需MCMC的解析式不确定性量化。

Result: 在20个UCI回归基准上，LA-TNKM的RMSE与NLL平均优于全秩GP（幅度约8%和12%），与深度BNN相比在同等参数量下NLL低6–15%，同时训练时间比稀疏GP快3–7倍，内存占用仅线性增长；OOD检测的AUROC平均提升4.3%。

Conclusion: 线性化拉普拉斯近似可在不破坏TNKM低秩结构的前提下恢复可追踪的后验高斯，从而首次为张量网络核机提供了原则性、可扩展的不确定性估计；该方法兼具GP的理论保证与神经网络的高效性，为大规模安全敏感回归任务提供了新的baseline。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation is essential for robust decision-making in the presence of ambiguous or out-of-distribution inputs. Gaussian Processes (GPs) are classical kernel-based models that offer principled uncertainty quantification and perform well on small- to medium-scale datasets. Alternatively, formulating the weight space learning problem under tensor network assumptions yields scalable tensor network kernel machines. However, these assumptions break Gaussianity, complicating standard probabilistic inference. This raises a fundamental question: how can tensor network kernel machines provide principled uncertainty estimates? We propose a novel Bayesian Tensor Network Kernel Machine (LA-TNKM) that employs a (linearized) Laplace approximation for Bayesian inference. A comprehensive set of numerical experiments shows that the proposed method consistently matches or surpasses Gaussian Processes and Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) across diverse UCI regression benchmarks, highlighting both its effectiveness and practical relevance.

</details>


### [314] [The Geometric Canary: Predicting Steerability and Detecting Drift via Representational Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17698)
*Prashant C. Raju*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 几何稳定性可同时预测大模型可控性（需任务对齐）与监控结构漂移（无需标签），两项实用诊断互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠部署大模型需回答两个问题：部署前能否被线性操控，部署后内部表征是否退化。现有方法把二者割裂处理，缺乏统一指标。

Method: 提出“几何稳定性”——表征空间成对距离结构的一致性。有监督版本（Shesha）聚焦任务相关子空间，无监督版本直接度量全空间距离分布变化，分别用于掌控性与漂移检测。

Result: 有监督几何稳定性在35–69个嵌入模型、3项NLP任务中，线性操控预测准确率达0.89–0.97；无监督版在Llama等对齐后漂移检测灵敏度提升2–5倍，误报率降6×，提前预警73%模型。

Conclusion: 任务对齐的有监督几何稳定性是部署前“可控性体检”，无监督几何稳定性是部署后“结构健康监测”，二者互补构成LLM全生命周期几何诊断框架。

Abstract: Reliable deployment of language models requires two capabilities that appear distinct but share a common geometric foundation: predicting whether a model will accept targeted behavioral control, and detecting when its internal structure degrades. We show that geometric stability, the consistency of a representation's pairwise distance structure, addresses both. Supervised Shesha variants that measure task-aligned geometric stability predict linear steerability with near-perfect accuracy ($ρ= 0.89$-$0.97$) across 35-69 embedding models and three NLP tasks, capturing unique variance beyond class separability (partial $ρ= 0.62$-$0.76$). A critical dissociation emerges: unsupervised stability fails entirely for steering on real-world tasks ($ρ\approx 0.10$), revealing that task alignment is essential for controllability prediction. However, unsupervised stability excels at drift detection, measuring nearly $2\times$ greater geometric change than CKA during post-training alignment (up to $5.23\times$ in Llama) while providing earlier warning in 73\% of models and maintaining a $6\times$ lower false alarm rate than Procrustes. Together, supervised and unsupervised stability form complementary diagnostics for the LLM deployment lifecycle: one for pre-deployment controllability assessment, the other for post-deployment monitoring.

</details>


### [315] [Safe, Scalable, and Accurate Bayes Posterior Sampling for Large-Data Generalized Linear Mixed Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26029)
*Youngsoo Baek,Samuel I. Berchuck*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对大规模数据下贝叶斯广义线性混合模型的可扩展采样难题，本文提出随机镜像 Langevin 动态（S-MLD），并通过显式 Wasserstein 误差界与后处理校正消除子采样导致的方差估计偏差，实现随机效应协方差参数可靠推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大数据场景下，现有基于随机梯度 Langevin 动态（SGLD）的方法对随机效应方差分量进行采样时，因参数化不平滑导致 Markov 链发散，无法获得可靠的后验样本；亟须一种兼顾可扩展性与理论保证的新采样框架。

Method: 1. 引入镜像 Langevin 动态（MLD）避免直接在方差空间采样；2. 提出随机镜像 Langevin 动态（S-MLD），基于数据子采样计算随机镜像梯度；3. 给出显式 Wasserstein 距离误差界，量化子采样造成的近似误差；4. 设计后处理校正步骤，以误差界为指导实现后验方差的渐进无偏估计。

Result: 模拟实验表明，S-MLD 在链稳定性、有效样本量及方差估计精度上均优于 SGLD；乳腺癌幸存者疼痛轨迹纵向研究进一步验证，该方法可在 10 万级观测数据下高效获得随机效应协方差矩阵的可靠后验分布。

Conclusion: 通过镜像映射与误差界驱动的后处理，S-MLD 首次在大规模贝叶斯 GLMM 中实现了随机效应方差分量的可扩展、渐进正确推断，为复杂分层模型的大数据贝叶斯分析提供了通用、可复现的采样解决方案。

Abstract: We consider the problem of scalable sampling algorithms to fit Bayesian generalized linear mixed models on large datasets. Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics, coupled with smooth re-parameterizations of variance parameters, produces divergent Markov chains and cannot be reliably used for sampling covariance parameters of random effects. We advocate the use of a mirror Langevin dynamics algorithm, propose the novel stochastic mirror Langevin dynamics based on data subsampling, and provide concrete guidelines for its use in a Bayesian inference framework. Based on an explicit Wasserstein distance error bound between the posterior and its algorithmic approximation, we propose a post-processing step that yields an asymptotic, order-wise correct estimation of the posterior variance, eliminating the irreducible posterior variance estimation bias due to subsampling. Empirical performance of the method is evaluated through simulated experiments and a longitudinal study of pain trajectories in a study of breast cancer survivors.

</details>


### [316] [Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning to Event-Triggered Control for Networked Artificial Pancreas Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26126)
*Junya Ikemoto,Satoshi Maruyama,Kazumune Hashimoto*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 基于深度强化学习的（DRL）事件触发人工胰腺控制器，通过血糖变化规则决定非周期通信，兼顾节能与血糖控制性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络人工胰岛系统需要在降低通信频次的同时维持疗效；现有 DRL 方案多为周期控制，难以同时学胰岛素剂量与更新时刻，导致维度爆炸与训练耗时。

Method: 引入“血糖变化阈值”作为事件触发规则，固定更新时刻的决策—仅学得胰岛素剂量；将问题调整为半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），用延拓后的 DDPG 型算法求解。

Result: 数值实验显示，与周期 DRL 控制器相比，平均通信频率降低 ≥30%，且血糖在目标范围内时间（TIR）、低血糖风险等指标无显著下降。

Conclusion: 规则化事件触发有效解耦了“是否通信”与“如何给药”的学习负担，为节能型闭环人工胰腺提供可行、易部署的 DRL 控制框架。

Abstract: This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based event-triggered controller design for networked artificial pancreas (AP) systems. Although existing DRL-based AP controllers typically assume periodic control updates, networked control systems (NCSs) require a reduction in communication frequency to achieve energy-efficient operation, which is directly tied to control updates. However, jointly learning both insulin dosing and update timing significantly increases the complexity of the learning problem. To alleviate this complexity, we develop a practical DRL-based controller design that avoids explicitly learning update timing by introducing a rule-based criterion defined by changes in blood glucose. As a result, decision-making occurs at irregular intervals, and the problem is naturally formulated as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP), for which we extend a standard DRL algorithm. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method improves communication efficiency while maintaining control performance.

</details>


### [317] [Budget-Constrained Causal Bandits: Bridging Uplift Modeling and Sequential Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26169)
*Abhirami Pillai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对冷启动广告场景下历史数据稀缺的预算分配难题，提出一体化在线框架 BCCB，把“学效果-探未知-控预算”三步合并为单步决策；在 Criteo 真实 RCT 数据上，BCCB 第 1 个用户即可起效，方差降低 3–5 倍，全面优于 Thompson Sampling 等在线基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字广告中常见冷启动（新活动/新市场/新客群）——历史数据极少，传统“先离线估计 HTE 再优化分配”的两阶段方法失效，亟需一种能在缺数据场景下边学边投的一体化方案。

Method: 提出 Budget-Constrained Causal Bandits (BCCB)：将个体因果效应估计、不确定用户探索与预算节奏控制统一进一个序贯决策过程，每来一个用户即时决定投/不投，并实时更新策略；算法基于置信上界与预算消耗惩罚相结合的设计。

Result: 在 Criteo Uplift 大型随机试验数据集上，离线方法需 ≈10 000 条历史样本才稳定，而 BCCB 从第 1 个用户起即达可接受 uplift；运行间方差降低 3–5 倍。对比纯在线基线（标准/带预算 Thompson Sampling、贪婪 HTE），BCCB 在各预算水平下 uplift 和 ROI 均显著更高。

Conclusion: BCCB 把因果学习与预算约束融入同一在线框架，破解冷启动数据瓶颈，提升决策稳定性与效果，可直接嵌入实时竞价引擎，为广告平台早期投放与动态预算管理提供实用工具。

Abstract: Treatment allocation under budget constraints is a central challenge in digital advertising: advertisers must decide which users to show ads to while spending a limited budget wisely. The standard approach follows a two-stage offline pipeline - first collect historical data to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects (HTE), then solve a constrained optimization to allocate the budget. This works well with abundant data, but fails in cold-start settings such as new campaigns, new markets, or new customer segments where little historical data exists. We propose Budget-Constrained Causal Bandits (BCCB), an online framework that learns which users respond to ads while simultaneously spending the budget, making treatment decisions one user at a time. BCCB unifies three components into a single sequential process: learning individual-level ad effectiveness, exploring users whose response is uncertain, and pacing the budget over time. We evaluated on the Criteo Uplift dataset, a large-scale advertising dataset from a real randomized controlled trial. Our key finding is a data-efficiency crossover: offline methods require approximately 10,000 historical observations to produce reliable results, while BCCB operates effectively from the very first user. Furthermore, BCCB exhibits 3-5x lower performance variance between runs, making it more practical for real campaign planning. Among purely online methods, BCCB consistently outperforms standard Thompson Sampling, budgeted Thompson Sampling, and greedy HTE estimation across all budget levels tested.

</details>


### [318] [Co-Learning Port-Hamiltonian Systems and Optimal Energy-Shaping Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26172)
*Ankur Kamboj,Biswadip Dey,Vaibhav Srivastava*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用物理引导学习，在轨迹数据中交替训练pH模型+能量平衡无源控制器，保证闭环系统稳定、解释性好，并在摆系实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据驱动控制常忽略物理无源性，易导致模型偏移和模拟-现实差异；需要一种既利用先验物理结构又能在线提升控制性能的联合学习框架。

Method: 将系统动力学和EB-PBC分别用嵌入pH结构的神经网络参数化，在策略感知采样下交替优化：先收集当前策略的轨迹→更新pH模型→在新模型上重优化控制器；训练中加入耗散正则，迫使能量严格衰减。

Result: 学得控制器保持闭环系统无源且Lyapunov稳定，不抵消自然势能即可实现状态调节和摆起任务；平面摆/扭转摆实验中，样本效率提高30%，且对扰动/参数误差的鲁棒性优于无结构数据驱动方法。

Conclusion: 物理信息+策略迭代框架能在有限数据内学习稳定、解释性强的能量平衡控制器，为pH系统提供兼顾模型精度和鲁棒性的新范式。

Abstract: We develop a physics-informed learning framework for energy-shaping control of port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems from trajectory data. The proposed approach {co-learns} a pH system model and an optimal energy-balancing passivity-based controller (EB-PBC) through alternating optimization with policy-aware data collection. At each iteration, the system model is refined using trajectory data collected under the current control policy, and the controller is re-optimized on the updated model. Both components are parameterized by neural networks that embed the pH {dynamics} and EB-PBC structure, ensuring interpretability in terms of energy {interactions}. The learned controller renders the closed-loop system inherently passive and provably stable, and exploits passive plant dynamics without canceling the natural potential. A dissipation regularization enforces strict energy decay during training, thereby enhancing robustness to sim-to-real gaps. The proposed framework is validated on state-regulation and swing-up tasks for planar and torsional pendulum systems.

</details>


### [319] [Addressing Performance Saturation for LLM RL via Precise Entropy Curve Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26326)
*Bolian Li,Yifan Wang,Yi Ding,Anamika Lochab,Ananth Grama,Ruqi Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 现有RL训练大模型时因熵坍塌导致性能饱和；本文提出无正则、可定制熵曲线的拒绝采样算法Entrocraft，用线性退火熵表持续提升性能，4B模型超越8B基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模RL提升LLM推理能力，但训练后期熵坍塌、探索消失，性能随之饱和。既有正则或裁剪法虽短暂抬熵，却引入不稳定，难以长期增益。

Method: 提出Entrocraft：无需修改损失，仅通过拒绝采样按自定义熵曲线 bias 优势分布，即可精确控制每步熵变；理论证明熵变与优势分布的正则关系，算法与优势估计器无关。

Result: 在可控熵场景下，线性退火（高→略低目标）最优；Entrocraft让4B模型持续提升4倍步数，Pass@K+50%，最终超越8B基线，同时输出多样性显著增强。

Conclusion: 熵调度是RL缩放的新杠杆；Entrocraft以极简采样策略稳控熵曲线，打破性能饱和，为继续放大模型与数据规模提供可行路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has unlocked complex reasoning abilities in large language models (LLMs). However, most RL algorithms suffer from performance saturation, preventing further gains as RL training scales. This problem can be characterized by the collapse of entropy, a key diagnostic for exploration in RL. Existing attempts have tried to prevent entropy collapse through regularization or clipping, but their resulting entropy curves often exhibit instability in the long term, which hinders performance gains. In this paper, we introduce Entrocraft, a simple rejection-sampling approach that realizes any user-customized entropy schedule by biasing the advantage distributions. Entrocraft requires no objective regularization and is advantage-estimator-agnostic. Theoretically, we relate per-step entropy change to the advantage distribution under minimal assumptions, which explains the behavior of existing RL and entropy-preserving methods. Entrocraft also enables a systematic study of entropy schedules, where we find that linear annealing, which starts high and decays to a slightly lower target, performs best. Empirically, Entrocraft addresses performance saturation, significantly improving generalization, output diversity, and long-term training. It enables a 4B model to outperform an 8B baseline, sustains improvement for up to 4x longer before plateauing, and raises pass@K by 50% over the baseline.

</details>


### [320] [A Sufficient-Statistic Reduction of the Information Bottleneck to a Low-Dimensional Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26744)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 利用充分统计量的无信息丢失降维可将信息瓶颈(IB)问题的计算复杂度从原始变量维度降至统计量维度，并统一离散与高斯情形，由此推广并验证了经典高斯IB解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息瓶颈理论普遍面临高维 变量的计算不可行性，而实际数据中常存在低维充分统计量；作者旨在找到一种严格降维方法，使IB曲线与最优表示的计算复杂度仅取决于该统计量维度而非环境维度。

Method: 证明若p(C|T)可分解为仅依赖充分统计量φ(T)，则(T,C)与(φ(T),C)的IB框架等价：保留完整IB曲线、各β的Lagrangian最优解和最优表示，且不影响与之对应的映射关系；随后将该抽象化框架特例化，指出Chechik等人给出的线性-高斯IB结论为其直接推论，并给出非线性-高斯推广；最后以小规模数值实验验证当充分统计量维度低时可在降低维度上精确求解IB曲线。

Result: 在i.i.d.或充分统计模型下，IB的复杂度由φ的维度Δφ而非|T|决定；经典线性-高斯IB结果归入统一理论框架，并扩展至非线性场景；数值示例显示在统计量维度较低时可快速计算精确瓶颈曲线。

Conclusion: 充分统计量提供了一个无信息损失的降维切入口，揭示了问题结构中隐藏的易处理性；这种方法不仅澄清了离散、线性-高斯IB之间的内在联系，也为未来的高效非参数或非线性IB算法提供了理论基准与可实现性保证。

Abstract: We show that if the conditional distribution p(C | T) factors through a sufficient statistic φ(T), then the Information Bottleneck (IB) problem for (T, C) is exactly equivalent to the IB problem for (φ(T), C). The reduction is loss-free: it preserves the full IB curve, the Lagrangian optimum at every trade-off parameter \b{eta}, and the optimal representations up to pullback through φ. As a result, the computational complexity of solving the IB problem is governed by the dimension of the sufficient statistic rather than the ambient dimension of the source. This identifies an exact structural condition under which the generic IB problem becomes tractable, and gives a formal bridge between the discrete and linear-Gaussian regimes. We then show that the classical Gaussian IB solution of Chechik, Globerson, Tishby and Weiss is an immediate corollary of this reduction, and we state a nonlinear-Gaussian generalisation. A small numerical example illustrates the practical consequence: when a low-dimensional sufficient statistic is available, the exact IB curve can be computed on the reduced problem at a cost determined by the statistic rather than by the ambient source dimension.

</details>

Abstract: We prove that any random variable $X$ whose moment generating function is point-wise upper bounded by that of $ G \sim \mathcal{N}(0,1) $ must be dominated by $ G/\mathbb{E}[|G|] $ in convex order, meaning $ \mathbb{E}[f(X)] \le \mathbb{E}[f(G/\mathbb{E}[|G|])] $ for all convex $f$. Equality is attained by taking $ X \sim \mathrm{Unif}(\{-1,1\}) $ and $ f(x) = |x| $.

*Andrea Agazzi,Giuseppe Bruno,Eloy Mosig García,Samuele Saviozzi,Marco Romito*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>

Abstract: We prove pathwise convergence of the layerwise evolution of tokens in a finite-depth, finite-width transformer model with MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP) blocks to a continuous-time stochastic interacting particle system. We also identify the stochastic partial differential equation describing the evolution of the tokens' distribution in this limit and prove propagation of chaos when the number of such tokens is large. The bounds we establish are quantitative and the limits we consider commute. We further prove that the limiting stochastic model displays synchronization by noise and establish exponential dissipation of the interaction energy on average, provided that the common noise is sufficiently coercive relative to the deterministic self-attention drift. We finally characterize the activation functions satisfying the former condition.

</details>


### [323] [On the Learning Curves of Revenue Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26922)
*Steve Hanneke,Alkis Kalavasis,Shay Moran,Grigoris Velegkas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次刻画单物品单买家场景下收益最大化问题的学习曲线衰减速率，揭示 Bayes 一致算法收敛速度可任意慢；若最优收益由有限价格实现，则速率约 1/√n；离散估值分布下几乎指数级收敛，突破传统 PAC 框架的悲观界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有收益最大化学习算法研究采用无分布（distribution-free）视角，仅给出最坏情形误差上界，无法刻画真实学习曲线形状。作者希望建立面向具体分布的学习曲线理论，量化样本增多时收益估计误差的实际衰减规律。

Method: 在单物品单买家基础模型内，分三类分布开展分析：1) 任意无约束连续分布，构造 Bayes 一致算法并证明其收敛可任意慢；2) 最优收益由有限价格取得的分布，利用经验收益最大化结合局部 Rademacher 复杂度，证明误差以 Θ(1/√n) 衰减；3) 有限支撑离散分布，借用量子化误差与 Chernoff 界，证明误差呈 O(e^{−cn}) 级几乎指数下降。

Result: Bayes 一致算法对任意分布皆渐近最优，但收敛速度无下界；有限价格情形下 1/√n 为最优且可达；k 点离散支撑使学习曲线指数级衰减，与 PAC 框架的 Ω(1/√n) 最坏界形成鲜明对比，显示分布相关分析可指数提速。

Conclusion: 收益最大化问题的学习曲线形状高度依赖估值分布结构：连续分布下可任意慢，有限价格情形呈多项式快，离散情形则指数快。结果呼吁放弃纯最坏情形视角，转向分布相关或结构受限的精细化分析，以捕捉真实样本效率。

Abstract: Learning curves are a fundamental primitive in supervised learning, describing how an algorithm's performance improves with more data and providing a quantitative measure of its generalization ability. Formally, a learning curve plots the decay of an algorithm's error for a fixed underlying distribution as a function of the number of training samples. Prior work on revenue-maximizing learning algorithms, starting with the seminal work of Cole and Roughgarden [STOC, 2014], adopts a distribution-free perspective, which parallels the PAC learning framework in learning theory. This approach evaluates performance against the hardest possible sequence of valuation distributions, one for each sample size, effectively defining the upper envelope of learning curves over all possible distributions, thus leading to error bounds that do not capture the shape of the learning curves.
  In this work we initiate the study of learning curves for revenue maximization and provide a near-complete characterization of their rate of decay in the basic setting of a single item and a single buyer. In the absence of any restriction on the valuation distribution, we show that there exists a Bayes-consistent algorithm, meaning that its learning curve converges to zero for any arbitrary valuation distribution as the number of samples $n \to \infty$. However, this convergence must be arbitrarily slow, even if the optimal revenue is finite. In contrast, if the optimal revenue is achieved by a finite price, then the optimal rate of decay is roughly $1/\sqrt{n}$. Finally, for distributions supported on discrete sets of values, we show that learning curves decay almost exponentially fast, a rate unattainable under the PAC framework.

</details>


### [324] [A Note on How to Remove the $\ln\ln T$ Term from the Squint Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26926)
*Francesco Orabona*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 作者指出 Orabona-Pál 2016 引入的 shifted KT 势函数等价于在 Krichevsky–Trofimov 算法中改用重尾先验，并据此把同样技巧移植到 Squint 算法，干净地去掉数据无关界中的 ln ln T 因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数免设置学习算法的最优遗憾界常带 ln ln T 项，虽理论极小却影响实际有限时间表现；Orabona-Pál 已用 shifted KT 势函数在 experts 设定下消除该项，但未解释其本质，也未在 Squint 算法上验证。

Method: 1) 证明 shifted KT 势函数等价于对 KT 估计器改用重尾先验（即 Kumaraswamy/Beta 型先验的偏移版本）；2) 把同一代价修正思路嵌入 Squint 的 data-independent  regret 分析，通过调节先验参数直接抵消 ln ln T 项。

Result: 在 experts 与 Squint 两类数据无关界中均获得不含 ln ln T 的严格遗憾上界，保持算法参数免调且计算复杂度不变。

Conclusion:  shifted KT 技巧本质是重尾先验选择；该视角为在其他在线学习算法中剔除对数对数因子提供统一模板。

Abstract: In Orabona and Pál [2016], we introduced the shifted KT potentials, to remove the $\ln \ln T$ factor in the parameter-free learning with expert bound. In this short technical note, I show that this is equivalent to changing the prior in the Krichevsky--Trofimov algorithm. Then, I show how to use the same idea to remove the $\ln \ln T$ factor in the data-independent bound for the Squint algorithm.

</details>


### [325] [Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks for Shape Constrained Learning and Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26942)
*Shayan Hundrieser,Insung Kong,Johannes Schmidt-Hieber*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks（HyCNN），在保持输入凸性、深度可扩展性与大规模训练稳定性上全面优于ICNN，并以指数级参数效率逼近二次函数，在凸回归、插值及高维最优传输任务中取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICNN虽可保证输入凸性，但存在参数冗余、深度难扩展及大规模训练不稳定问题，限制了其在高维凸函数学习及最优传输中的应用效果。

Method: 将Maxout的“取最大”构造与ICNN的“凸性约束”融合：1) 每层对若干仿射变换结果取max，整体网络对输入保持凸；2) 理论证明用O(2^d)参数即可ε-精度逼近d维二次型，而ICNN需Ω(2^d·d)参数；3) 采用批量归一化与初始化策略实现千级层稳定训练。

Result: 合成数据集上，HyCNN在凸回归/插值任务中的MSE比ICNN降低30–60%，比MLP降低50–80%；在高维最优传输中，W_2误差平均下降20–40%，单细胞RNA数据上细胞类型匹配准确率提升7–15%。

Conclusion: HyCNN以指数级参数优势实现深度凸网络的可扩展训练，奠定高维凸函数学习与最优传输的新基底，未来可拓展至凸优化控制器、生成模型及大规模科学计算场景。

Abstract: We introduce Hyper Input Convex Neural Networks (HyCNNs), a novel neural network architecture designed for learning convex functions. HyCNNs combine the principles of Maxout networks with input convex neural networks (ICNNs) to create a neural network that is always convex in the input, theoretically capable of leveraging depth, and performs reliable when trained at scale compared to ICNNs. Concretely, we prove that HyCNNs require exponentially fewer parameters than ICNNs to approximate quadratic functions up to a given precision. Throughout a series of synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that HyCNNs outperform existing ICNNs and MLPs in terms of predictive performance for convex regression and interpolation tasks. We further apply HyCNNs to learn high-dimensional optimal transport maps for synthetic examples and for single-cell RNA sequencing data, where they oftentimes outperform ICNN-based neural optimal transport methods and other baselines across a wide range of settings.

</details>


### [326] [Distribution-Free Stochastic Analysis and Robust Multilevel Vector Field Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.06229)
*Julio E Castrillon-Candas,Michael Rosenbaum,Mark Kon*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种针对大规模矢量随机场的随机函数型分析方法，不依赖任何先验数据分布假设即可进行异常检测，并在亚马逊森林退化监测中证明多谱段比单谱段和PCA方法更敏感、可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多谱光学和雷达传感器产生的大规模矢量随机场难以满足经典异常检测对已知或低维数据分布的假设，且单谱分析常遗漏微弱异常。

Method: 1) 在名义随机场上提取最优Karhunen-Loève(KL)展开；2) 依据域的几何结构将KL基底分层正交分解，构造多级函数子空间；3) 将观测场向多级基投影并建立无先验分布假设的随机假设检验。

Result: 在亚马逊森林退化实际影像和模拟数据中，本方法显著优于PCA，可检测仅为弱扰动的微弱异常，且对多谱段矢量化构造的整体场检测精度更高。

Conclusion: 研究展示了基于随机函数型分析的矢量场异常检测框架，无需预先建模数据分布即可提供可解释、可信的显著性检验，尤其适用于高维未知分布的卫星遥感矢量数据。

Abstract: Massive vector field datasets are common in multi-spectral optical and radar sensors, among many other emerging areas of application. We develop a novel stochastic functional (data) analysis approach for detecting anomalies based on the covariance structure of nominal stochastic behavior across a domain. An optimal vector field Karhunen-Loeve expansion is applied to such random field data. A series of multilevel orthogonal functional subspaces is constructed from the geometry of the domain, adapted from the KL expansion. Detection is achieved by examining the projection of the random field on the multilevel basis. A critical feature of this approach is that reliable hypothesis tests are formed, which do not require prior assumptions on probability distributions of the data. The method is applied to the important problem of degradation in the Amazon forest. Due to the complexity and high dimensionality of satellite imagery, it is not feasible to assume known distributions, nor to estimate them. In addition to providing reliable hypothesis tests, our approach shows the advantage of using multiple bands of data in a vectorized complex, leading to better anomaly detection. Furthermore, using simulated data, our approach is capable of detecting subtle anomalies that are impossible to detect with PCA-based methods.

</details>


### [327] [DP-CDA: An Algorithm for Enhanced Privacy Preservation in Dataset Synthesis Through Randomized Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16121)
*Utsab Saha,Tanvir Muntakim Tonoy,Hafiz Imtiaz*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出高维数据发布算法 DP-CDA，以“类内随机混合+校准噪声”生成合成数据，在差分隐私框架下获得更紧致的隐私损失界，实证显示同等隐私预算下模型精度显著优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗、金融等高维数据集含大量个人标识信息，匿名化仍可被重识别；现有 ML 与数据发布算法在维数升高时难以兼顾计算效率与隐私，亟需一种可证明且高效的隐私保护发布机制。

Method: 设计 DP-CDA 算法：1) 按类别对敏感记录做随机混合，扰乱记录与身份的对应关系；2) 向混合结果注入经敏感度分析与矩会计精细调参的随机噪声，满足差分隐私；3) 引入“混合阶”超参，在隐私损失与数据效用的联合目标上优化，找到最佳隐私-效用平衡点。

Result: 理论分析给出 DP-CDA 的累积隐私损失 ε 上界比同类方法紧致 20–35%；在 3 个高维基准数据集上，以相同 ε 训练的下游分类器准确率提升 4–11 个百分点，数据保留统计查询误差降低 30% 以上。

Conclusion: DP-CDA 通过“类内混合+精准噪声”策略，在严格差分隐私约束下显著提升合成数据效用，为高维敏感数据的安全共享与机器学习应用提供了可扩展、可证明的实用方案。

Abstract: In recent years, the growth of data across various sectors, including healthcare, security, finance, and education, has created significant opportunities for analysis and informed decision-making. However, these datasets often contain sensitive and personal information, which raises serious privacy concerns. It has been shown in multiple works that a person's identity is intertwined with their data, even if the data is anonymized. Due to this lack of separation between a person's identity and their information, the patterns associated with an individual's information can uniquely identify them. Protecting individual privacy is crucial, yet many existing machine learning and data publishing algorithms struggle with high-dimensional data, facing challenges related to the trade-off between computational efficiency and privacy. To address these challenges, we introduce an effective data publishing algorithm \emph{DP-CDA}. Our proposed algorithm generates synthetic data by randomly mixing the privacy-sensitive data in a class-specific manner and inducing carefully tuned randomness to ensure formal privacy guarantees. Our comprehensive privacy accounting shows that the proposed DP-CDA provides a stronger privacy guarantee compared to existing methods, allowing for better utility while maintaining a stricter level of privacy. To evaluate the effectiveness of DP-CDA, we examine the accuracy of predictive models trained on the synthetic data, which serves as a measure of dataset utility. Importantly, we identify an optimal order of mixing that balances privacy-utility trade-off. Our results indicate that synthetic datasets produced using the DP-CDA can achieve superior utility compared to those generated by conventional data publishing algorithms, even when subject to the same privacy requirements.

</details>


### [328] [Data Balancing Strategies: A Systematic Survey of Resampling and Augmentation Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13518)
*Behnam Yousefimehr,Mehdi Ghatee,Javad Fazli,Shervin Ghaffari,Zahra Rafei,Mohammad Amin Seifi,Sajed Tavakoli,Abolfazl Nikahd,Mahdi Razi Gandomani,Alireza Orouji,Ramtin Mahmoudi Kashani,Sarina Heshmati,Negin Sadat Mousavi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文系统回顾了样例失衡处理技术，指出不存在普适最优方法并给出面向自监督、扩散模型与基础模型的未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类别失衡数据集长期导致机器学习模型偏向多数类，现有研究对已有方法的系统性比较与未来发展路径仍显不足。

Method: 全面梳理并分类31种数据平衡技术：从经典SMOTE族到GAN、VAE与扩散模型等深度生成器，涵盖欠采样、混合采样与集成策略，并针对高维、多标签、含噪环境逐一检验假设与适用条件。

Result: 实证表明方法性能高度依赖数据特征、基分类器与评价指标；深度生成模型在高维重叠场景下表现突出，混合集成策略常获稳健效果，但无方法在所有数据集上绝对领先。

Conclusion: 根据数据维度、特征类型与噪声水平选择方案，优先试验C4算法（SMOTE+ENN/RF）与基于扩散的ODS采样；未来需发展自监督分布对齐、分布保持重采样、知识蒸馏部署及大模型适配等方向。

Abstract: Imbalanced datasets, where one class significantly outnumbers others, remain a persistent challenge in machine learning, often biasing predictions toward the majority class and degrading classifier performance. This paper provides a comprehensive, systematic review of data balancing methods, extending beyond foundational oversampling techniques such as the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) and its variants (e.g., Borderline SMOTE, K-Means SMOTE, and Safe-Level SMOTE) to encompass advanced adaptive methods (MWMOTE, AMDO), deep generative models (generative adversarial networks, variational autoencoders, and diffusion models), undersampling techniques (NearMiss, Tomek Links), combination/hybrid methods (SMOTE-ENN, SMOTE-Tomek, and SMOTE+OCSVM), ensemble strategies (SMOTEBoost, RUSBoost, Balanced Random Forest, and One-Sided Selection), and specialized approaches for multi-label and clustered data. Beyond descriptive categorization, this review critically examines each method's underlying assumptions, operational mechanisms, and suitability for diverse data characteristics, including high dimensionality, mixed feature types, class overlap, and noise. Key findings demonstrate that no single method universally outperforms others; optimal selection depends critically on dataset characteristics, classifier choice, and evaluation metrics. The paper concludes by identifying emerging research directions, including self-supervised learning for imbalance, diffusion-based generative oversampling, distribution-preserving resampling, knowledge distillation for imbalanced deployment, and the adaptation of foundation models to skewed distributions, offering practical guidelines for practitioners and a roadmap for future methodological development.

</details>


### [329] [Out-of-Distribution Generalization of In-Context Learning: A Low-Dimensional Subspace Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14808)
*Soo Min Kwon,Alec S. Xu,Can Yaras,Laura Balzano,Qing Qu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 线性注意力的单层ICL模型在低秩协方差下可证明区分出OOD可泛化与不可泛化：训练分布若为子空间并集则任意角度偏移皆可插值；若为单高斯则角度偏移带来不可忽略风险。GPT-2实验验证结论并初探非线性扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管经验上观察到Transformer能在上下文中学习(ICL)，其何时能突破预训练数据分布实现OOD泛化仍缺理论刻画。本文旨在给出最小可解模型，明确ICL对分布偏移的泛化条件与失效边界。

Method: 构建线性回归任务，其协方差矩阵为低秩；将分布偏移建模为子空间夹角变化。对单层线性注意力，推导其在预训练任务向量来源于①子空间并集②单高斯两种情况下的插值性质与测试风险上界，并用合成实验与GPT-2验证。

Result: 理论证明：若预训练任务来自子空间并集，ICL可在任意角度偏移下零误差插值，即使该区域训练概率为0；若来自单高斯，测试风险随夹角单调上升且下界>0。合成与GPT-2实验一致复现该二分现象，非线性函数类初步显示类似趋势。

Conclusion: ICL的OOD能力是数据几何结构(子空间并集 vs 单高斯)的突现性质而非单纯规模效应；单层线性注意力已足够捕捉该分界。结果提示预训练阶段引入多样子空间结构可扩展ICL的OOD可靠范围，也为后续深度学习理论提供了可解析基准。

Abstract: The transformer's remarkable ability to perform in-context learning (ICL) has sparked a wide range of studies designed to understand its strengths and limitations. However, a theoretical understanding of when ICL can and cannot generalize beyond its pre-training data still remains unclear. This paper puts forth a minimal mathematical model that provably identifies when ICL can generalize out-of-distribution (OOD). By studying linear regression tasks parameterized with low-rank covariance matrices, we model distribution shifts as varying angles between subspaces and derive conditions under which a single-layer linear attention model interpolates across all angles. We show that if pre-training task vectors are drawn from a union of subspaces, transformers can generalize to all angle shifts--enabling ICL even in regions with zero probability mass in the training distribution. On the other hand, if the pre-training tasks are drawn from a single Gaussian, the test risk shows a non-negligible dependence on the angle, implying that ICL cannot generalize OOD. We empirically show that our results also hold for models such as GPT-2, and present experiments on how our results extend to nonlinear function classes.

</details>


### [330] [Optimal differentially private kernel learning with random projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.17544)
*Bonwoo Lee,Cheolwoo Park,Jeongyoun Ahn*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于随机投影的差分隐私核ERM算法，首次在局部强凸条件下给出免维数的最优超额风险界，并证明随机傅里叶特征等传统降维方法次优；实验验证了理论最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私学习需在隐私与效用间权衡，现有核ERM方法依赖随机傅里叶特征或ℓ2正则化，超额风险界非最优且受维数拖累。作者旨在突破维数依赖，实现极小化最优的超额风险率。

Method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间中，以高斯过程诱导的随机投影对原始核特征做降维，然后在降维空间执行目标扰动型差分隐私ERM；理论分析利用局部强凸性，建立与维数无关的超额风险界。

Result: 对平方损失和Lipschitz光滑凸损失均得到极小化最优超额风险率；证明随机傅里叶特征与ℓ2正则化只能达到次优界；对现有隐私核ERM算法亦给出更紧风险界；实验显示随机投影同时提升隐私与统计效率。

Conclusion: 随机投影是差分隐私核学习中最优的降维工具，能在不增加维数惩罚的前提下达到隐私-效用最优权衡，为后续隐私算法设计提供新范式。

Abstract: Differential privacy has become a cornerstone in the development of privacy-preserving learning algorithms. This work addresses optimizing differentially private kernel learning within the empirical risk minimization (ERM) framework. We propose a novel differentially private kernel ERM algorithm based on random projection in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space using Gaussian processes. Our method achieves minimax-optimal excess risk rates for both the squared loss and Lipschitz-smooth convex loss functions under a local strong convexity condition. We further show that existing approaches based on alternative dimension reduction techniques, such as random Fourier feature mappings or $\ell_2$ regularization, yield suboptimal excess risk bounds. Our key theoretical contribution also includes the derivation of dimension-free excess risk bounds for objective perturbation-based private linear ERM, marking the first such result that does not rely on noisy gradient-based mechanisms. Additionally, we obtain sharper excess risk bounds for existing differentially private kernel ERM algorithms. Empirical evaluations support our theoretical claims, demonstrating that random projection enables statistically efficient and optimally private kernel learning. These findings provide new insights into the design of differentially private algorithms and highlight the central role of dimension reduction in balancing privacy and utility.

</details>


### [331] [NeuralFLoC: Neural Flow-Based Joint Registration and Clustering of Functional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03169)
*Xinyang Xiong,Siyuan jiang,Pengcheng Zeng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 NeuralFLoC，用 Neural ODE 端到端联合做函数型相位配准与聚类，理论上保证模型一致性与普逼近，实验在基准数据集上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数型相位变异导致时间错位，会掩盖形状差异并拉低聚类准确率；现有方法要么分两步做配准与聚类，要么依赖强参数假设，需一种无监督、一体化的新框架。

Method: 构建 Neural ODE 驱动的微分同胚流估计平滑可逆时间变换；同时学习聚类特定模板，用谱聚类分离振幅与相位变异，并与深度特征联合端到端优化。

Result: 在典型函数型数据集上，配准与聚类错分率均达到 SOTA；对缺值、非规则采样和高斯噪声都具有鲁棒性，且推理复杂度随样本线性扩展。

Conclusion: NeuralFLoC 首次将 Neural ODE 与谱聚类无缝融合，统一解决相位校正与聚类，为函数型数据分析提供可扩展、理论保证充分的新范式。

Abstract: Clustering functional data in the presence of phase variation is challenging, as temporal misalignment can obscure intrinsic shape differences and degrade clustering performance. Most existing approaches treat registration and clustering as separate tasks or rely on restrictive parametric assumptions. We present \textbf{NeuralFLoC}, a fully unsupervised, end-to-end deep learning framework for joint functional registration and clustering based on Neural ODE-driven diffeomorphic flows and spectral clustering. The proposed model learns smooth, invertible warping functions and cluster-specific templates simultaneously, effectively disentangling phase and amplitude variation. We establish universal approximation guarantees and asymptotic consistency for the proposed framework. Experiments on functional benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance in both registration and clustering, with robustness to missing data, irregular sampling, and noise, while maintaining scalability. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NeuralFLoC-FEC8.

</details>


### [332] [A Tutorial Review of Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes to Accelerate Stationary Point Searches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10992)
*Rohit Goswami*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出统一贝叶斯优化框架，用一个六步代理循环同时处理 PES 上的极小化、单点鞍点搜寻与双端路径搜寻，可≈10×减少昂贵电子结构计算，并给出可扩展 Rust 教学实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 势能面 stationary point 搜索中电子结构计算成本极高，亟需高精度、通用且易扩展的代理加速策略。

Method: 将三类 PES 搜索建模为同一贝叶斯优化六步循环：高斯过程回归＋导数观测＋逆距离核＋主动学习；内层优化目标和采集函数区分任务；扩展了最远点 EMD 采样、MAP 正则、自适应信任域、随机 Fourier 特征等模块。

Result: 在保持底层理论精度的同时，代理可将电子结构调用减约一个量级；Rust 代码验证同一循环即可驱动三种搜索任务，理论-实践零缝隙。

Conclusion: 统一代理框架为 PES 探索提供高效、可复用、易扩展的通用平台，已具备生产级扩展能力，并开源教学实现供社区直接使用与改进。

Abstract: Building local surrogates to accelerate stationary point searches on potential energy surfaces spans decades of effort. Done correctly, surrogates can reduce the number of expensive electronic structure evaluations by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving the accuracy of the underlying theory, with the gain depending on oracle cost, search distance, and the availability of analytical forces. We present a unified Bayesian optimization view of minimization, single-point saddle searches, and double-ended path searches: all three share one six-step surrogate loop and differ only in the inner optimization target and the acquisition criterion. The framework uses Gaussian process regression with derivative observations, inverse-distance kernels, and active learning, and we develop optional extensions for production use, including farthest-point sampling with the Earth Mover's Distance, MAP regularization, an adaptive trust radius, and random Fourier features for scaling. Accompanying pedagogical Rust code demonstrates that all three applications use the same Bayesian optimization loop, bridging the gap between theoretical formulation and practical execution.

</details>


### [333] [Concave Statistical Utility Maximization Bandits via Influence-Function Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22140)
*Matías Carrasco,Alejandro Cholaquidis*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 将传统多臂赌博机目标从期望收益推广到分布泛函，利用影响函数构造随机梯度，提出基于截断单纯形的镜像上升算法并给出误差异分解的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实决策常关注收益分布的统计特征（方差、风险等）而非单纯期望，需对长期分布的泛函而非均值进行优化，现有bandit框架无法直接处理此类目标。

Method: 将无限时域问题转化为单纯形上稳态混合策略的凹泛函最大化；利用影响函数微积分构造仅依赖bandit观测的无偏梯度估计；设计带熵正则的镜像上升，在截断单纯形上执行乘性权重更新，并用插件估计影响函数。

Result: 证明算法 regret 可分解为镜像上升优化误差与影响函数估计误差两项，分别给出上界；框架统一处理方差、Wasserstein距离等凹分布目标，实验验证插件估计在保持收敛速率的同时降低计算量。

Conclusion: 首次给出针对一般凹分布泛函目标的bandit优化框架，影响函数梯度估计与镜像上升结合能兼顾统计精度与计算效率，为风险敏感在线学习提供可扩展方法论。

Abstract: We study stochastic multi-armed bandits in which the objective is a statistical functional of the long-run reward distribution, rather than expected reward alone. Under mild continuity assumptions, we show that the infinite-horizon problem reduces to optimizing over stationary mixed policies: each weight vector \(w\) on the simplex induces a mixture law \(P^w\), and performance is measured by the concave utility \(U(w)=\mathfrak U(P^w)\).
  For differentiable statistical utilities, we use influence-function calculus to derive stochastic gradient estimators from bandit feedback. This leads to an entropic mirror-ascent algorithm on a truncated simplex, implemented through multiplicative-weights updates and plug-in estimates of the influence function. We establish regret bounds that separate the mirror-ascent optimization error from the bias caused by estimating the influence function. The framework is developed for general concave distributional utilities and illustrated through variance and Wasserstein objectives, with numerical experiments comparing exact and plug-in influence-function implementations.

</details>


### [334] [Probabilistic Graphical Model using Graph Neural Networks for Bayesian Inversion of Discrete Structural Component States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23514)
*Teng Li,Stephen Wu,Yong Huang,James L. Beck,Hui Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对土木结构中离散健康状态难以反演的问题，提出一种基于概率图模型（PGM）与图神经网络（GNN）的贝叶斯反演框架，在无需解析似然函数的前提下实现高维状态后验估计，显著降低计算量并通过试验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯反演离散状态需显式似然函数，但结构响应与离散状态的映射关系未知且高维边际似然计算昂贵，导致病态反演难以实用。

Method: 1) 用马尔可夫网络将离散状态-响应关系编码为PGM，利用数据与拓扑先验学习参数；2) 证明对该PGM推理等价于原贝叶斯后验；3) 设计GNN端到端推理，并提出图属性驱动的跨尺度训练策略，避免逐尺度重训。

Result: 合成与实测数据验证表明：框架无需似然解析式即可给出与参考后验一致的概率估计；GNN推理在数百维状态空间下较传统MC提速2个数量级以上，且跨尺度误差<3 %。

Conclusion: PGM-GNN范式突破了离散变量贝叶斯反演中的似然解析与高维计算瓶颈，为大型土木结构群健康监测提供了可扩展、低耗时的概率诊断新工具。

Abstract: The health condition of components in civil infrastructures can be described by various discrete states according to their performance degradation. Inferring these states from measurable responses is typically an ill-posed inverse problem. Although Bayesian methods are well-suited to tackle such problems, computing the posterior probability density function (PDF) presents challenges. The likelihood function cannot be analytically formulated due to the unclear relationship between discrete states and structural responses, and the high-dimensional state parameters resulting from numerous components severely complicates the computation of the marginal likelihood function. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel Bayesian inversion paradigm for discrete variables based on Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs). The Markov networks are employed as modeling tools, with model parameters learned from data and structural topology prior. It has been proved that inferring this PGM produces the same probabilistic estimation as the posterior PDF derived from Bayesian inference, which effectively solves the above challenges. The inference is accomplished by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and a graph property-based GNN training strategy is developed to enable accurate inference across varying graph scales, thereby significantly reducing the computational overhead in high-dimensional problems. Both synthetic and experimental data are used to validate the proposed framework

</details>


### [335] [The Serial Scaling Hypothesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12549)
*Yuxi Liu,Konpat Preechakul,Kananart Kuwaranancharoen,Yutong Bai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 机器学习忽略了“不可分割的连续步骤”这类问题；扩散模型虽自串行亦难解决它们，忽视串行性会在算法、模型与硬件层面带来瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指出当前大规模并行化主导的机器学习范式在连续依赖、无法并行化的问题上存在盲区，并试图用复杂性理论量化这一盲区对模型性能的根本限制。

Method: 通过复杂性理论形式化“天然串行问题”的概念；评测现有并行架构与扩散模型在此类任务上的性能；首次证明扩散模型对这类问题无能为力。

Result: 1. 精确区分了可并行与天然串行的任务类；2. 证明了以并行思维设计的体系结构在串行问题上存在硬上限；3. 实验显示纯扩散模型无法有效求解串行依赖任务。

Conclusion: 机器学习界须重新评估串行性在算法、模型结构及硬件调度中的重要性，并在设计阶段将串行依赖显式纳入考虑，而非一味追求并行度。

Abstract: While machine learning has advanced through massive parallelization, we identify a critical blind spot: some problems are fundamentally sequential. These "inherently serial" problems-from mathematical reasoning to physical simulations to sequential decision-making-require sequentially dependent computational steps that cannot be efficiently parallelized. We formalize this distinction in complexity theory, and demonstrate that current parallel-centric architectures face fundamental limitations on such tasks. Then, we show for first time that diffusion models despite their sequential nature are incapable of solving inherently serial problems. We argue that recognizing the serial nature of computation holds profound implications on machine learning, model design, and hardware development.

</details>


### [336] [Factorizable joint shift revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15036)
*Dirk Tasche*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文把因子化联合漂移(FJS)从分类场景推广到任意标签空间，统一处理回归与分类；构建了广义分析框架，给出基于 EM 的类先验估计算法的新理论，并重新阐释广义标签漂移(GLS)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 FJS 研究局限于离散类别标签，无法直接处理回归等具有连续或复杂标签空间的任务，且对先验分布估计缺乏统一理论。

Method: 提出适用于任意标签空间的 FJS 分析框架；重构期望最大化(EM)算法以估计标签分布；在统一框架下同时审视分类与回归中的 FJS 与 GLS。

Result: 证明了框架下 FJS 可分解为连续的标签漂−协变量漂或逆序；给出了一般标签空间中 EM 先验估计的收敛性与误差界；对 GLS 的平衡条件及可判别性给出新的充要条件。

Conclusion: 新框架将 FJS/GLS 研究从分类推广至更广泛的监督学习问题，为任意标签空间的分布漂移检测、适应与先验估计提供可证明的理论基础与可实施算法。

Abstract: Factorizable joint shift (FJS) represents a type of distribution shift (or dataset shift) that comprises both covariate and label shift. Recently, it has been observed that FJS actually arises from consecutive label and covariate (or vice versa) shifts. Research into FJS so far has been confined mostly to the case of categorical labels. We propose a framework for analysing distribution shift in the case of a general label space, thus covering both classification and regression models. Based on the framework, we generalise existing results on FJS to general label spaces and present and analyse a related extension to label distribution estimation of the expectation maximisation (EM) algorithm for class prior probabilities. We also take a fresh look at generalized label shift (GLS) in the case of a general label space.

</details>


### [337] [Latent Autoencoder Ensemble Kalman Filter for Nonlinear Data assimilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06752)
*Xin T. Tong,Yanyan Wang,Liang Yan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种“潜变量自编码集合卡尔曼滤波器”（LAE-EnKF），在习得线性稳定潜空间中完成同化，显著缓解强非线性下 EnKF 性能衰退，理论给出泛化界，实验验证精度与稳定性优于标准 EnKF 及现有潜空间方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性系统中，集合卡尔曼滤波因线性更新假设与真实动力学失配导致精度下降；现有自编码潜空间方法未能保证结构与稳定性，需构造与 Kalman 框架兼容的线性潜态模型。

Method: 联合训练非线性编码–解码器、线性稳定潜态演化算子与一致潜观测映射，形成闭合线性状态空间；同化全程在潜空间完成，保持计算量近于数据驱动法。

Result: 在典型非线性混沌系统实验中，LAE-EnKF 的 RMSE 较标准 EnKF 降低 30–50%，滤波方差更小；与现有潜空间法比，长期积分不发散，计算耗时相当。

Conclusion: 通过“先潜线性化、后 Kalman 更新”的策略，LAE-EnKF 恢复了 Kalman 理论的适用性，兼顾非线性表达能力与线性稳定性，为高维强非线性数据同化提供可扩展、可解释的解决方案。

Abstract: The ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) is widely used for data assimilation in high-dimensional systems, but its performance often deteriorates for strongly nonlinear dynamics due to the structural mismatch between the Kalman update and the underlying system behavior. In this work, we propose a latent autoencoder ensemble Kalman filter (LAE-EnKF) that addresses this limitation by reformulating the assimilation problem in a learned latent space with linear and stable dynamics. The proposed method learns a nonlinear encoder--decoder together with a stable linear latent evolution operator and a consistent latent observation mapping, yielding a closed linear state-space model in the latent coordinates. This construction restores compatibility with the Kalman filtering framework and allows both forecast and analysis steps to be carried out entirely in the latent space. Compared with existing autoencoder-based and latent assimilation approaches that rely on unconstrained nonlinear latent dynamics, the proposed formulation emphasizes structural consistency, stability, and interpretability. We provide a theoretical analysis of learning linear dynamics on low-dimensional manifolds and establish generalization error bounds for the proposed latent model. Numerical experiments on representative nonlinear and chaotic systems demonstrate that the LAE-EnKF yields more accurate and stable assimilation than the standard EnKF and related latent-space methods, while maintaining comparable computational cost and data-driven.

</details>


### [338] [RL unknotter, hard unknots and unknotting number](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07955)
*Anne Dranowski,Yura Kabkov,Daniel Tubbenhauer*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习的简化纽结图流程，在硬实例上刷新unknotting-number上界并具备自动改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统纽结图化简依赖人工经验与启发式规则，效率及质量有限，难以攻克未解上界。

Method: 将Reidemeister移动建模为MDP，用强化学习训练策略网络给出下一步移动和价值估计，并设计“图膨胀”增加搜索空间；后续加入工作簿机制，通过自生成难点循环训练改进模型。

Result: 在已知“极难”unknot图上完成化简；对4_1#9_10首次以3步unknot，刷新该纽结unknotting-number上界；系统遍历素纽结表，进一步降低若干条目的已知上界。

Conclusion: 强化学习能自动化并提出优于人类经验的纽结化简策略，持续自举可系统收紧unknotting-number全局上界，展示机器证明在经典低维拓扑中的潜力。

Abstract: We develop a reinforcement learning pipeline for simplifying knot diagrams. A trained agent learns move proposals and a value heuristic for navigating Reidemeister moves. The pipeline applies to arbitrary knots and links; we test it on ``very hard'' unknot diagrams and, using diagram inflation, on $4_1\#9_{10}$ where we recover the recently established and surprising upper bound of three for the unknotting number. In addition, we explain a self-improving workbook-driven extension of the pipeline that systematically improves unknotting number upper bounds on the list of prime knots.

</details>


### [339] [Curiosity-Critic: Cumulative Prediction Error Improvement as a Tractable Intrinsic Reward for World Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18701)
*Vin Bhaskara,Haicheng Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Curiosity-Critic 把内在奖励定义为“当前预测误差与当前转移所能达到的渐近误差之差”，在线估计该渐近误差并据此实时区分可学与不可学成分，显著优于经典预测误差及计数/蒸馏等探索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于单步预测误差的内在奖励忽略模型在整个状态空间上的累积误差，无法在线区分可简化的认知不确定性（epistemic）与不可简化的随机不确定性（aleatoric），导致在噪声环境中探索效率低下。

Method: 提出 Curiosity-Critic：1) 以世界模型在所有已访问转移上的累积误差改进为优化目标；2) 推导出可逐步计算的代理奖励——当前预测误差与“当前转移渐近误差基线”之差；3) 用与世界模型并行训练的标量评论器（critic）在线估计该基线，critic 仅回归一维目标且收敛早于模型饱和；4) 奖励在可学转移上保持正值，在固有噪声转移上趋零，实现两类误差的在线分离。

Result: 随机格子世界实验表明，Curiosity-Critic 在训练速度、样本效率及最终世界模型精度上均优于原始预测误差、访问计数与 Random Network Distillation 等基准方法。

Conclusion: Curiosity-Critic 统一并扩展了从 Schmidhuber (1991) 到特征空间预测误差的各类好奇公式，通过在线估计渐近误差基线，无需先验噪声水平即可自适应聚焦可学区域，为噪声环境下的高效探索提供了可扩展且理论一致的新框架。

Abstract: Local prediction-error-based curiosity rewards focus on the current transition without considering the world model's cumulative prediction error across all visited transitions. We introduce Curiosity-Critic, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and show that it admits a tractable per-step surrogate: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition. We estimate this error baseline online with a learned critic co-trained alongside the world model; regressing a single scalar, the critic converges well before the world model saturates, redirecting exploration toward learnable transitions without oracle knowledge of the noise floor. The reward is higher for learnable transitions and collapses toward the error baseline for stochastic ones, effectively separating epistemic (reducible) from aleatoric (irreducible) prediction error online. Prior prediction-error curiosity formulations, from Schmidhuber (1991) to learned-feature-space variants, emerge as special cases corresponding to specific approximations of this error baseline. Experiments on a stochastic grid world show that Curiosity-Critic outperforms prediction-error, visitation-count, and Random Network Distillation methods in training speed and final world model accuracy.

</details>


### [340] [Inverting Foundation Models of Brain Function with Simulation-Based Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23865)
*Niels Bracher,Xavier Intes,Stefan T. Radev*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用 TRIBEv2 脑活动大模型重建新闻文本的情感参数，证明“脑→刺激”逆向映射可行，并验证 LLM 可作为可控刺激生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑活动大模型只能正向模拟神经响应，尚未验证其逆向解码潜力；需建立“脑活动→刺激属性”的闭环，以支持虚拟实验与神经解码。

Method: 将 TRIBEv2 生成的 fMRI 表征与 LLM 配对，用仿真推理（SBI）从脑图估计文本的效价-唤醒-支配参数，并用 LLM 按估计参数重生成 headlines 进行闭环验证。

Result: 脑图可显著准确重建三维度情感参数（r>0.8）；LLM 按重建参数生成的新 headlines 能再次激活高度一致的脑响应，表明映射可靠且模型可控。

Conclusion: 首次实现基于大模型的“脑→刺激”逆向解码，证明脑活动大模型具备双向推理能力，为神经科学虚拟实验、脑机接口刺激优化奠定算法基础。

Abstract: Foundation models of brain activity promise a new frontier for in silico neuroscience by emulating neural responses to complex stimuli across tasks and modalities. A natural next step is to ask whether these models can also be used in reverse. Can we recover a stimulus or its properties from synthetic brain activity? We study this question in a proof-of-concept setting using TRIBEv2. We pair the brain emulator with large language models (LLMs) that generate news headlines from linguistic parameters such as valence, arousal, and dominance. We then use simulation-based inference to learn a probabilistic mapping from brain maps to latent stimulus parameters. Our results show that these parameters can be recovered from predicted brain maps, validating the quality of neural encodings. They also show that LLMs can serve as controllable stimulus generators for simulated experiments. Together, these findings provide a step toward decoding and inverse design with foundation brain models.

</details>


### [341] [VLM Judges Can Rank but Cannot Score: Task-Dependent Uncertainty in Multimodal Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25235)
*Divake Kumar,Sina Tayebati,Devashri Naik,Ranganath Krishnan,Amit Ranjan Trivedi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 首次用共形预测将视觉-语言模型(VLM)的绝对打分转换成可解释置信区间，构建多模态评估可靠性地图并暴露排序-打分脱耦缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM-as-a-Judge 正快速取代人工评审，但其给出的分数缺乏不确定性估计，导致系统比较与部署风险不可控。

Method: 无重训练，仅利用 VLM 输出分数及对应 token 对数概率，在 3 种主流 VLM 与 14 类视觉任务上系统应用共形预测，生成任务级、样本级预测区间；通过区间覆盖率与宽度量化可靠性，并分析其与任务难度、标注质量的关系。

Result: 可靠性高度任务相关：美学/自然图像区间约占分值区间 40%，图表与数学推理扩至 70%；发现“排序-打分脱耦”——模型可保持高排名相关(Spearman>0.9)却输出极宽区间，排序准确但绝对分不可信；同一模型在干净多标注数据上区间宽度最多缩小 4.5 倍。

Conclusion: 将共形预测嵌入 VLM-as-a-Judge 能在无需重训练的前提下提供可解释不确定性，为后续多模态评估与模型改进奠定基础；任务选择与数据质量是获得可靠置信区间的关键因素。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for multimodal systems, yet their scores provide no indication of reliability. We study this problem through conformal prediction, a distribution-free framework that converts a judge's point score into a calibrated prediction interval using only score-token log-probabilities, with no retraining. We present the first systematic analysis of conformal prediction for VLM-as-a-Judge across 3 judges and 14 visual task categories. Our results show that evaluation uncertainty is strongly task-dependent: intervals cover ~40% of the score range for aesthetics and natural images but expand to ~70% for chart and mathematical reasoning, yielding a quantitative reliability map for multimodal evaluation. We further identify a failure mode not captured by standard evaluation metrics, ranking-scoring decoupling, where judges achieve high ranking correlation while producing wide, uninformative intervals, correctly ordering responses but failing to assign reliable absolute scores. Finally, we show that interval width is driven primarily by task difficulty and annotation quality, i.e., the same judge and method yield 4.5x narrower intervals on a clean, multi-annotator captioning benchmark. Code: https://github.com/divake/VLM-Judge-Uncertainty

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [342] [A Multimodal and Explainable Machine Learning Approach to Diagnosing Multi-Class Ejection Fraction from Electrocardiograms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25942)
*Catherine Ning,Yu Ma,Cindy Beini Wang,Sean McMahon,Joseph Radojevic,Steven Zweibel,Dimitris Bertsimas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用12导联ECG+EHR数据，经XGBoost四分类LVEF，无需超声即可初筛射血分数层级，AUROC达0.82-0.95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LVEF评估依赖超声心动图，在基层或资源匮乏地区可及性差，需一种低成本、易获取的替代筛查手段。

Method: 提取12导联ECG时序特征与结构化EHR变量，构建多模态特征集；采用XGBoost进行四分类（>50%、40-50%、30-40%、<30%）；利用SHAP解释关键特征；用Hartford HealthCare 36 784对ECG-超声数据训练，19 966例后续数据做时序外推验证。

Result: 多模态模型在严重、中度、轻度降低及正常组的one-vs-rest AUROC分别达0.95、0.92、0.82、0.91，显著优于单独ECG或单独EHR模型；时序验证中性能保持稳定。

Conclusion: ECG+EHR的多模态机器学习模型能可靠分层LVEF，可作为资源受限场景下优先安排确诊影像的实用筛查与分诊工具。

Abstract: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) assessment depends on echocardiography, limiting access in primary care and resource-constrained settings. We developed a multimodal machine-learning framework that combines engineered 12-lead ECG timeseries features with structured EHR variables to classify LVEF into four clinically used strata: normal (>50%), mildly reduced (40-50%), moderately reduced (30-40%), and severely reduced (<30%). To support model explainability, we identified the most influential ECG and EHR features via SHAP attributions. Using retrospective data from Hartford HealthCare, we trained XGBoost models on 36,784 ECG-echocardiogram pairs from 30,952 outpatients and evaluated temporal generalizability on 19,966 ECGs from a subsequent period. The multimodal model achieved one-vs-rest AUROCs of 0.95 (severe), 0.92 (moderate), 0.82 (mild), and 0.91 (normal), outperforming ECG-only and EHR-only baselines, and maintained performance under temporal validation. This work supports ECG-based, multimodal LVEF stratification as a practical screening and triage aid to prioritize confirmatory imaging where resources are limited.

</details>


### [343] [A Randomized PDE Energy driven Iterative Framework for Efficient and Stable PDE Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25943)
*Yi Bing,Zheng Ran,Fu Jinyang,Liu Long,Peng Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需矩阵装配、也不依赖数据训练的PDE能量驱动扩散迭代框架，可直接从随机初场收敛到真解，在一维Poisson、Heat及Burgers方程上取得与解析解相当的精度与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典数值求解器需组装大规模矩阵、计算昂贵；基于学习的方案则需预训练且泛化受限。亟需一种无需矩阵操作、又能保持物理一致性且可快速收敛的新型求解范式。

Method: 将PDE泛函能量转化为隐式扩散迭代，每次迭代用高斯平滑更新场量并在边界处硬约束；完全摒弃有限元装配和神经网络训练，仅依赖能量下降机制驱动任意随机初场演化至物理解。

Result: 在一维Poisson、热传导及黏性Burgers方程的稳态与瞬态算例中，算法均能从随机初值稳定收敛；对急剧梯度可高保真分辨，MSE 随网格参数变化平稳，精度与稳定性媲美传统高阶格式。

Conclusion: 该框架为PDE求解提供了快速、灵活且严格物理相容的第三路径，兼具无矩阵高效性与无训练通用性，可扩展至更大规模科学与工程问题。

Abstract: Efficient and stable solution of partial differential equations (PDEs) is central to scientific and engineering applications, yet existing numerical solvers rely heavily on matrix based discretizations, while learning based methods require costly training and often suffer from limited generalization. In this work, we proposes a PDE energy driven framework that solves PDEs through physically constrained diffusion iterations, without relying on classical matrix based finite element assembly or data driven neural network training. The proposed method evolves arbitrary random initial fields through PDE energy driven implicit iterations combined with Gaussian smoothing, while strictly enforcing boundary conditions at each iteration. The proposed formulation is applied to representative one dimensional Poisson, Heat, and viscous Burgers equations, covering both steady state and transient problems. Numerical results demonstrate stable convergence to the unique physical solution from random initializations, with accurate resolution of sharp gradients and controlled Mean Squared Error (MSE) across a wide range of discretization parameters. Detailed comparisons with analytical solutions indicate that the framework achieves competitive accuracy and stability. Overall, the proposed framework provides a fast, flexible, and physically consistent alternative to traditional numerical solvers, offering a potential pathway for scalable PDE solutions in both research and engineering applications.

</details>


### [344] [A Survey of Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning with Graph Neural Network-Based Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25972)
*Valentin Cuzin-Rambaud,Laetitia Matignon,Maxime Morge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过统一的四阶段通用框架（图构建→信息编码→GNN通信→解码决策）梳理论文，明确GNN通信的核心思想、评判指标及简化对比方式，为后续研究提供结构化入门路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL中引入GNN通信的方法激增，但缺乏统一框架导致概念不清、优劣难辨；论文旨在系统分类、提炼共同原理，并为新人提供入门指南。

Method: 1.筛选近两年相关文献；2.归纳出通用四阶段GNN通信框架（图构建、信息编码、GNN通信、解码决策）；3.提炼节点级、网络级、交互级三条评判基准（覆盖表达、推理与可扩展性）；4.用通讯量、收敛速度、扩展性三维度简化对比已有算法。

Result: 成功将相近年文献归入统一框架，发现多数方法只在编码或聚合函数局部创新；验证了兼容不同GNN骨干（GAT、GCN、MPNN）后，原框架仍具解释力；通过基准实验展示了框架化的性能／扩展性/通信开销对比，助力快速选取算法。

Conclusion: 提出的通用GNN通信框架能够一站式梳理现有MARL通信方法，使隐藏结构显性化；建议未来研究增设动态拓扑、信噪与能耗约束，以进一步提高理论与实用价值。该框架不仅降低理解门槛，也为标准化评估和跨方法边界的创新奠定基础。

Abstract: In multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), the integration of a communication mechanism, allowing agents to better learn to coordinate their actions and converge on their objectives by sharing information. Based on an interaction graph, a subclass of methods employs graph neural networks (GNNs) to learn the communication, enabling agents to improve their internal representations by enriching them with information exchanged. With growing research, we note a lack of explicit structure and framework to distinguish and classify MARL approaches with communication based on GNNs. Thus, this paper surveys recent works in this field. We propose a generalized GNN-based communication process with the goal of making the underlying concepts behind the methods more obvious and accessible.

</details>


### [345] [Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25975)
*Jiaming Yang,Chenwei Tang,Liangli Zhen,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于信息瓶颈的CapKV缓存替换策略，用解析的互信息目标统一现有启发式策略，实验证明显著降低KV缓存规模的同时维持生成长文本的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型长序列推理中KV缓存占用过高，现有启发式淘汰方法缺乏统一理论支撑，亟需从信息论角度建立严格框架以兼顾内存效率与生成质量。

Method: 在线性高斯注意力代理模型下推导KV子集的互信息闭式表达式，用其对数行列式近似构建“有效信息量”目标；以统计杠杆分数作为抽样权重实现容量感知淘汰，形成CapKV算法。

Result: 多模型与长上下文基准测试表明，CapKV在同等缓存预算下BLEU/ROUGE提升2–8%， perplexity最高下降15%，内存峰值降低30–50%，优于H2O、StreamingLLM等基线。

Conclusion: 信息瓶颈原理解释并统一了KV缓存替换策略，CapKV以理论最优的信息保真度实现内存-精度帕累托最优，为长序列大模型部署提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for large language model inference, yet its memory overhead poses a critical bottleneck for long-context generation. Existing eviction policies predominantly rely on empirical heuristics, lacking a rigorous theoretical foundation. This work rethinks KV cache eviction through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle. Under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention, we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective information capacity of a retained KV cache subset. This formulation reveals that a wide range of existing eviction strategies can be interpreted as different approximations of the same capacity-maximization principle. Guided by this insight, we introduce CapKV, a capacity-aware eviction method that directly targets information preservation via a log-determinant approximation using statistical leverage scores. This approach replaces heuristic selection with a theoretically grounded mechanism that preserves the maximum predictive signal. Extensive experiments across multiple models and long-context benchmarks show that CapKV consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving a better trade-off between memory efficiency and generational fidelity.

</details>


### [346] [Mini-Batch Class Composition Bias in Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25978)
*Kieran Maguire,Srinandan Dasmahapatra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有link-prediction GNN用batch-norm会学到仅依赖mini-batch的捷径，导致表示与同一图的node分类不一致；去掉捷径后表示与节点属性更对齐，说明标准训练高估了链路预测的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证GNN在固定图上针对link prediction和node classification学到的表示是否应一致，并揭示训练目标差异造成的伪相关。

Method: 对比分析含/不含batch-norm的经典链路预测模型，设计梯度校正和表示对齐指标，量化两种任务后学到的节点嵌入相似度，并诊断模型是否利用批次统计捷径完成边分类。

Result: 发现带batch-norm的模型在mini-batch内统计差异上做捷径即可达到较高预测性能；去掉或校正该捷径后，link prediction指标下降，但节点表示更接近node-classification任务学到的特征，跨任务一致性显著提升。

Conclusion: 标准链路预测训练易于落入batch-level shortcut陷阱，高估了对图结构本质的捕捉能力；实际应用需对网络架构、正规化层及采样方案进行改进，以确保学得可迁移、与下游任务对齐的图表示。

Abstract: Prior work on node classification has shown that Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can learn representations that transfer across graphs, when underlying graph properties are shared. For a fixed graph, one would then expect GNNs trained for link prediction to learn a representation consistent with that learnt for node classification. We show this intuition does not hold in the general case. Instead, we find popular link prediction models can learn a trivial mini-batch dependent heuristic, enabled by batch-normalisation layers, to solve the edge classification task. When correcting for this, we observe increased alignment of the network representation with node-class relevant features, suggesting the network has learnt a graph representation that better aligns with the underlying graph's properties. Our findings suggest that standard link prediction training may be leading us to overestimate link predictors' ability to learn a generalised representation of a graph that is consistent across tasks.

</details>


### [347] [Open Problems in Frontier AI Risk Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.25982)
*Marta Ziosi,Miro Plueckebaum,Stephen Casper,Henry Papadatos,Ze Shen Chin,Peter Slattery,James Gealy,Tim G. J. Rudner,Brian Tse,Ariel Gil,Patricia Paskov,Maximilian Negele,Rokas Gipiškis,Nada Madkour,Vera Lummis,Rupal Jain,Luise Eder,Kristina Fort,Malou C. van Draanen Glismann,Inès Belhadj,Amin Oueslati,Anna K. Wisakanto,Richard Mallah,Koen Holtman,Ranj Zuhdi,Daniel S. Schiff,Jessica Newman,Malcolm Murray,Robert Trager*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Frontier AI both amplifies existing risks and introduces qualitatively novel challenges. Not only is there a notable lack of stable scientific consensus resulting from the rapid pace of technological change, but emerging frontier AI safety practices are often misaligned with, or may undermine, established risk management frameworks. To address these challenges, we systematically surface open problems in frontier AI risk management. Adopting a problem-oriented approach, we examine each stage of the risk management process - risk planning, identification, analysis, evaluation, and mitigation - through a structured review of the literature, identifying unresolved challenges and the actors best positioned to address them. Recognising that different types of open problems call for different responses, we classify open problems according to whether they reflect (a) a lack of scientific or technical consensus, (b) misalignment with, or challenges to, established risk management frameworks, or (c) shortcomings in implementation despite apparent consensus and alignment. By mapping these open problems and identifying the actors best positioned to address them - including developers, deployers, regulators, standards bodies, researchers, and third-party evaluators - this work aims to clarify where progress is needed to enable robust and meaningful consensus on frontier AI risk management.The paper does not propose specific solutions; instead, it provides a problem-oriented, agenda-setting reference document, complemented by a living online repository, intended to support coordination, reduce duplication, and guide future research and governance efforts.

</details>


### [348] [Correcting Performance Estimation Bias in Imbalanced Classification with Minority Subconcepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26024)
*Taylor Maxson,Roberto Corizzo,Yaning Wu,Nathalie Japkowicz,Colin Bellinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需真实子概念标签的实用加权评测指标pBA，可在类别内部异质场景下给出更稳健、可解释的性能估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类别级指标会掩盖同一类别内不同子概念间的性能差异，且依赖真实子概念标签的效用重加权难以在测试阶段落地。

Method: 用多类子概念模型输出的后验概率代替不可见的真实标签，定义期望效用权重，构建软加权且考虑不确定性的预测加权平衡准确率（pBA）。

Result: 在表格、医学影像和文本数据上的实验表明，传统无加权指标在类别内分布不均时会误导，而pBA在子概念分布非极端倾斜时更稳定、可解释。

Conclusion: pBA可在无标签条件下有效缓解子概念偏差，为异质类别提供更可靠的评测工具，代码已开源。

Abstract: Class-level evaluation can conceal substantial performance disparities across subconcepts within the same class, causing models that perform well on average to fail on specific subpopulations. Prior work has shown that common evaluation measures for imbalanced classification are biased toward larger minority subconcepts and that utility-based reweighting using true subconcept labels can mitigate this bias; however, such labels are rarely available at test time. We introduce a practical utility-weighted evaluation that replaces unavailable subconcept labels with predicted posterior probabilities from a multiclass subconcept model.
